_comment: CI fails on any increase over these baselines. A commit that increases a value must update it here with a comment explaining why. Updated 2026-09-06: settings-dialog.tsx grew to 677 loc from the ChatGPT-style two-pane rework (borderless sidebar, inset content card, test/save feedback states, provider link helper); settings pane removed but feedback markup and timers added lines.
